paite: Pathian aw, pau lou in om ke'nla; Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke'n, om maimai mahmah ke'n.
heading: Asaph phatna La; La khat. / Israelte Melmate Zohna Dia Thumna
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

paite: Ngai in, na melmate alum lutlut ua; nangmah hote adak hekhawk uhi.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

paite: Na mite lepchiahtak in asawm ua, na mi selgukte tung ah aselam in akihou akihoukhawm uhi.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

paite: Kisa dih ua, anam uh mangsak khop in i hihmang ding uh; Israel min himhim theihgige a a-om nawnlouhna ding in, achi uhi.
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

paite: Thukhat sat in akihou ua; na tung ah aselam a hih ding in thu achiamkhawm uhi.
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

paite: Edom leh Ishmael puaninte, Moab leh Haggar;
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

paite: Gebal leh Ammon leh Amalek; Philistiate Tura a omte toh,
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

paite: Assuriate amau lam ah apang ua; Lot suante apanpih uhi. Selah
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

paite: Amau Midiante tung a na hih bang, Kishon lui a Sisera tung a na hih bang, Jabin tung a na hih bang in hih sam in.
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

paite: Huai mite Endor ah amang ua; lei a ding in eklei bang lel ana hita uhi.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

paite: Amiliante uh Oreb leh Zeeb bang in bawl inla, Ahi, a kumpipa tengteng uh Zebah leh Zalmunna bang in bawl in.
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

paite: Huai mite'n, Pathian omnate i luahsak ding uh, achi uhi.
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

paite: Ka Pathian aw, amaute leivui kipei lunglung bang in bawl in; buhsi huih mutleng bang in.
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

paite: Gam kang mei bang leh, tang kang meikuang bang in.
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

paite: Amau na huihpi in delh inla, na huih thupitak in hihlau in.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min a zontheihna ding un amel uh zumna in hihdim in.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

paite: Tangtawn in zahlak leh mangbangtak in om uhenla; ahi, hihzum a om in mangthang uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

paite: Nangmah kia Jehovah min pu, leitung tengteng tung a Tungnungpen na hi chih atheihna ding un.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
